Definition: adverb from G4089; bitterly, i.e. (figuratively) violently:--bitterly.
BiblicalUsage: Pikros as an adverb means bitterly. Peter went out and wept bitterly after denying Jesus, in Matthew 26:75 and Luke 22:62 — the same word in both Gospels for the same tears.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe bitter tears after a fall are the beginning of coming back, not the end.
